title: The fixed marts: res/field/shops/marts.json
description: The shops 0 to 25 that Scrcmd_Shop_CallFriendlyShopBuy opens with a list of their own, file shop + 6 of archive a/2/8/2 (ShopUI_LoadPokeMartItems in src/ov036/scrcmd_shop.c), which tools/data/shop_data.py packs: the Pokémon Centers' second clerks, Shopping Mall Nine's counters, Driftveil City's market and Nacrene City's café. A field script opens one by setting 0x8000 to its ID before calling global script 10110. Each item costs its price in its own data (res/items/<item>/data.json), less with the Bargain Pass Power, and a list whose first item is a TM or HM shows the TMs' numbers and moves. A string value is the name of a constant from generated/ or include/constants/.

shop.description: The shop's ID, as the scripts give it

name.description: Where the shop is, for people and editors; the game doesn't read it

group.description: What kind of shop it is, for editors to group them: a Pokémon Center's second clerk, a counter of Shopping Mall Nine (White 2's department store), or a market stall

items.description: The items in menu order, at most 45 (ShopUIWork's entries); Virbank City's (22) at most 44, as Paper White 2 adds the Shiny Candy after them
